Urinalysis:
Specific Gravity
(Sp.Gr.)
Specimen midstream clean-catch 
if infection suspected, or regular 
collection. Dip Stick or labora-
tory testing for Specific Gravity.
One of a multiple of tests on a urine 
specimen. Sp.Gr. is a measure of 
concentration of particles and 
electrolytes in the urine.
Adult:
1.005-1.030 Sp.Gr.
Newborn:
1.001-1.020 Sp.Gr.
Appearance can also give subjec-
tive indication of fluid concen-
tration; darker color 5 higher 
concentration.
